# netbox_power_feed (Data Source)

A power feed from a panel to a rack (dcim.powerfeed).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/powerfeed/):

> A power feed represents the distribution of power from a power panel to a particular device, typically a power distribution unit (PDU). The power port (inlet) on a device can be connected via a cable to a power feed. A power feed may optionally be assigned to a rack to allow more easily tracking the distribution of power among racks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_power_feed" "test" {
  name = "test-power_feed"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `power_panel_id` (Number) Id of the power panel the feed starts at.
- `rack_id` (Number) Id of the rack the feed serves.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: offline, active, planned, failed.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.
- `type` (String) Whether the feed is the primary or the redundant one. One of: primary, redundant.

### Read-Only

- `amperage` (Number) Amperage of the feed.
- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) Treat the feed as connected even without a cable.
- `max_percent_utilization` (Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of max_utilization_percent.
- `max_utilization_percent` (Number) Maximum permitted draw as a percentage.
- `phase` (String) Phase type. One of: single-phase, three-phase.
- `supply` (String) Supply type. One of: ac, dc.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
- `voltage` (Number) Voltage of the feed.
